verdict: ROAS dipped this week; ad creative and overdue deliverables are being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads generated 35 purchases on $1,442.22 in spend, returning $6,060.72 in revenue at a 4.2x return on ad spend. This past week, however, return on ad spend fell roughly 32% week-over-week — purchase count held flat while revenue per dollar eroded, a pattern consistent with ad creative that has been in rotation too long. At the same time, Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply over the last few days, which we are monitoring closely as it affects local visibility. Ad creative is being refreshed and several overdue project milestones — including subscribe pages, automation flows, and UTM tracking — are being moved to completion this period.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend across the full 28-day window
purchases driven through Meta ads this period
week-over-week drop in return on ad spend, actively being addressed

watch_item.issue: Return on ad spend declined sharply this week as ad creative shows signs of fatigue, and Google Business Profile actions went dark for three consecutive days.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed now, and Google Business Profile health is being investigated alongside the creative update.
